verdict.rationale: Runloop's docs describe Devboxes as 'secure sandboxed execution environments' and 'isolated Linux sandbox environments', and document egress network policies. None of this names the isolation mechanism, so the hard boundary the story asks for is only implied, not documented. Missing for 10: a documented microVM/VM-level (or equivalent, e.g. gVisor) isolation boundary, a kernel/tenant separation description, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation strength.
